item.title: Graffiti all along the road, 3rd August
item.description:
From around Mr Milligans Golf, on both sides of the road, every single lamp post, utility boxes, walls and fences has been spray painted, on both sides of the road. Around 100 lampposts, 20 green/grey utility boxes, road signs, and walls have been completely covered in graffiti. I reported this about a year ago but it’s been ignored. It’s a horrendous sight when driving into or out of the bexley/bromley,greenwich boroughs. I could only attach 3 photos sadly, but they give you an idea.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Sidcup By-pass, Longlands, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: No yellow lines on corner, 3rd August
item.description:

Should there not be double yellow lines along the corners and so far down the road, to stop potential incidents?
